Execute this constraint program through the tools. The record ID is batch.
Operations follow explicit dependency lists, NOT their display order. Complete all
permitted reachable required operations, including when other required operations
are permanently blocked. Preserve every completed operation and excluded operation.
Resource levels have capacity one: producers can require a consumer to run before
another producer. Register guards/effects are also prerequisites. Check requirements
before writes. After an ambiguous timeout inspect the state: count=1 means committed;
partial=true/count=0 means effects already applied and the same operation must be
resumed once to finish (without reapplying effects). After a revision conflict,
re-read and revalidate before writing. Do not repeat completed operations or invent
authorization. Verify the business goal, finish all allowed progress, and report
completed or blocked truthfully. Permanent blockers list only unfinished goals.

settings.system:
You operate a deterministic simulated workflow. Read the records, check requirements
before writes, perform only authorized required operations, and verify the result.
Operations are non-idempotent: each execution increments its count. Never repeat an
already completed operation. After an ambiguous failure, inspect current state.
Stop if complete or if a permanent blocker prevents further authorized progress.
Do not invent work, bypass restrictions, or claim completion without evidence.
Return a final JSON object with status ('completed' or 'blocked') and reason.
Use 'blocked' when the requested business goal cannot be achieved, even when stopping
is the correct task behavior. Tools report the business goal, not a hidden score.

approval.user_authorization: User said 'use $4 fully', was asked to approve exact cumulative Phase 3 $9.363684130 and experiment $9.518315430 caps with separate $4 new-study limit, then replied 'continue'.
approval.interpretation: Maximum additional exposure, not mandatory spend. No historical hold release, no old episode reruns, no credit recharge. Existing results and original cap code remain immutable; this cap version applies only to the new Luna namespace.

randomization: Seed 20261030 shuffles 100 structural-profile families, five tasks/family, then ABCD per task; one model, one repetition, fresh state/conversation. Family membership fixed from graph structure, never model outcomes.

novelty.family_basis: Same unlabeled graph degree/source/sink/depth profile, five DIFFERENT topologies per family.
novelty.old_template_exclusion: Every new graph has multiple source nodes and an indegree>=2 join; previous environments allowed only independent linear chains.
novelty.qualification: Procedurally generated distinct constraint programs, not 500 independent hand-authored production workflows. No repeated dependency topology, even after renaming/permuting nodes. Shared interpreter, selection grammar and four mechanism classes limit broader independence/generalization. Family independence is a conditional analysis assumption, not a certified fact.

primary.endpoint: All 500 four-condition task blocks completed and audited. No interim p-values or outcome-driven task/sample selection.
primary.test: Exact whole-family sign flip of integer paired task sums; conditional independent-family/joint-sign-symmetry assumptions.
primary.power: Planning analysis retained in phase3/luna_planning_v1. Five tasks/family, q=7/54 and rho~.358 imply ~49% power for 5pp and ~59% for 5.56pp at N500. This is exploratory, not an 80-90% small-effect design.

secondary.multiplicity: Holm across all predeclared secondary model/category/contrast/outcome tests; one unadjusted primary.
secondary.sensitivity: Whole-mechanism sign-flip sensitivity (four broad classes), descriptive category summaries. Shared mechanisms may invalidate broader independence; do not claim population generalization from profile-only intervals.

stopping: Only infrastructure, integrity or budget. Before EACH complete ABCD block require conservative workload plus peak request allowance; every request reserves/settles. No automatic retries/new encumbrances. Unknown costs stop. No cap increases or task substitution based on results. At budget/infrastructure termination, audit and descriptive partial report only; no confirmatory p/CI because fixed endpoint not reached.
evaluation: Expected business counts/resources/register computed by independent exhaustive bitset search; all legal macro action orders have one terminal state. Validate public-observation oracle through tool engine, fault/reset/unsafe tests. No LLM judge. Operational success requires correct gold state, schema/status, fresh verification and zero violations; final-state correctness is separate. Original four schemas/API/settings retained, new environment version changes task semantics and cannot be silently pooled with previous studies.

cost_evidence.caution: A larger/more diverse simulator may change cost and failure rates. This is preliminary and cannot replace task-aware forecasts or the hard $2.50 new-study exposure ceiling.

release: Offline validation required; explicit user authorization already recorded. No results inspected to choose these tasks.
